title: 第14章：夜二少心里发酸
slug: 天价萌妻全本免费-天价萌妻最新章节列表
content_zh:
夜爵回头看了眼徐雅然，这个女人青涩得咬一口都嫌牙酸，居然被别人捷足先登了？
想到她在别的男人身下呻吟，夜爵心里居然涌起了一股酸味……这是肿么一回事？
“好了，我到了，感谢夜总送我回家，夜总请慢走。”夜爵还没想明白，徐雅然已拉开车门跳下车，转身离开。
徐雅然回到家时已经快10点了，许静还没有回来。
许静学的是建筑结构工程学设计，在慕氏集团建筑部上班，是国内首屈一指的女建筑工程师。
这次即将和慕云笙大婚，所以休假了并未去上班，结果中午时接到电话，说慕氏在郊区的工程出了问题，于是匆匆忙忙赶去了。
欢欢身体不好，宁宁已经让她睡下了。
听到徐雅然回家的声音，宁宁宝贝忙起床去给她热菜。
徐雅然看着宁宁宝贝系着围裙在厨房里忙活的小身影，让身为妈咪的徐雅然小小地愧疚了一下……
“宝贝，妈咪好爱你！”徐雅然走过去，抱住宁宁宝贝猛地亲了一口。
“妈咪，我也爱你！”宁宁回亲了一下徐雅然的脸蛋。
“呜呜……”徐雅然很感动，儿子啊，虽然你爹是个禽兽，但你和欢欢仍然是上天送给妈咪最好的礼物！
“妈咪，我和欢欢会永远爱你，你不要这样拉，快出去，马上就能吃了！”
宁宁宝贝将徐雅然赶出厨房，不一会儿，便端了几盘菜和一碗米饭出来。
徐雅然狼吞虎咽，有儿子在真好，呜呜……都要饿死她了……
“妈咪，你慢点！”怕徐雅然噎着，宁宁宝贝忙递上去一杯水，又问道，“妈咪，今天在夜皇的工作怎么样啊？”
宁宁宝贝中午给徐雅然打电话的时候得知自家妈咪还没面完试，就被直接要求上班了，直感概爹地动作真快！
想到工作，徐雅然就想咆哮，“传闻果然是骗人的，都说夜爵有八大秘书，我去一看，毛都没看见，妈咪整了一天的文件，累死了！”
“……”
宁宁宝贝默了，妈咪我对不起你，他当初只想着赶紧把他家妈咪弄到爹地身边，居然忘了这茬。

“那妈咪……夜皇的环境怎么样啊？新上司有木有很凶？”宁宁宝贝拐弯抹角。
徐雅然想到夜爵，又看着面前的宁宁宝贝……那五官，那眉眼，居然是如此的相像，明显一个模子刻出来的啊啊啊！
徐雅然心中无比怨念，她当年是有多么的年幼无知啊，就算夜爵当年没有那么霸气、冷冽，就冲他那风骚的模样，她也不能把他当成男公关啊！！！
还留了她以前的手机号！
还说……不是故意嫖了不给钱……徐雅然都能想象到夜爵看到她留下的那张纸条时是多么的低气压！
徐雅然的表情千变万化，宁宁忙问道，“妈咪，怎么了？新上司很难缠么？”他家爹地不会那么变态吧？
“岂止难缠，简直就是心理变态，妈咪看见他就食欲不振，心情不好！”
“……”
宁宁宝贝几乎确定她家妈咪想起爹地来了，但是……这回忆貌似并不好美好啊！
宁宁宝贝认识到自己的错误，赶忙把夜皇招聘总裁秘书的邮箱给改了回来，没几天便又入职了4个人，均是工作经验丰富，谈吐得体的白领美女。
其中还有一个也曾在SK国际集团担任过布洛克一年的秘书，名叫白莉莉，比徐雅然大三岁，两人聊到布洛克的变态习惯时，纷纷捶桌咆哮。
白莉莉对于徐雅然小小年纪却能在布洛克手底下工作2年多表示十分惊讶，要知道布洛克是有多么的变态，平均一个月要换一次秘书，要求又高，咖啡多加一勺糖都不行，还不能是花痴和花瓶。
徐雅然对白莉莉的印象也很好，两人十分投缘。
剩下的三人分别名叫张嘉芸、薛丽敏、元媛。
徐雅然见人三分笑，人际交往一向不错，再加上与这几人年纪相仿，于是很快打成一片。
周五下午，明天不用上班，张嘉芸提议一起出去吃饭、唱K，庆祝新加入夜皇。
辛苦了一周，徐雅然本想早点回去陪自家两个小宝贝，便想拒绝，但看到大家都是新入职，且除了她之外都很热情高涨，便没有拒绝。
夜爵隔着玻璃窗看着外面秘书室的五个女人，目光落在徐雅然身上，这个女人真是越看越眼熟，但是他又想不起来在哪里见过……夜爵不喜欢这种感觉，很不喜欢！

content_en:
Ye Jue turned around and glanced at Xu Yaran. This woman was so young that her teeth felt sore when she took a bite. How could someone else take advantage of her?
Thinking of her moaning under another man, Ye Jue felt a sour taste in his heart... What was this?
"Okay, I'm here. Thank you to the nightclub for taking me home. Please walk slowly." Before Ye Jue could figure it out, Xu Yaran had opened the car door, jumped out of the car, and turned around to leave.
It was almost 10 o'clock when Xu Yaran got home, and Xu Jing hadn't come back yet.
Xu Jing studied architectural structural engineering design and works in the construction department of Mu Group. She is one of the leading female construction engineers in the country.
This time I was about to get married to Mu Yunsheng, so I didn't go to work during my vacation. However, I received a call at noon saying that there was a problem with Mu's project in the suburbs, so I hurried there.
Huanhuan was not in good health, so Ning Ning had already put her to sleep.
Hearing the sound of Xu Yaran coming home, Baby Ningning hurriedly got up and went to give her hot food.
Xu Yaran looked at the little figure of baby Ning Ning wearing an apron and working in the kitchen, which made Xu Yaran, a mother, feel a little guilty...
"Baby, Mommy loves you so much!" Xu Yaran walked over, hugged baby Ningning and kissed her hard.
"Mommy, I love you too!" Ning Ning kissed Xu Yaran's face back.
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu" Xu Yaran was very touched, son, although your father is a beast, you and Huanhuan are still the best gifts from God to mommy!
"Mommy, Huanhuan and I will love you forever. Don't act like this. Get out quickly and you can eat it right away!"
Baby Ningning drove Xu Yaran out of the kitchen, and after a while, she came out with several plates of vegetables and a bowl of rice.
Xu Yaran wolfed down the food. It was so good to have her son here. Ugh...she was about to starve to death...
"Mommy, slow down!" Afraid that Xu Yaran would choke, Baby Ning Ning hurriedly handed over a glass of water and asked, "Mommy, how was your work at Night Emperor today?"
When baby Ning Ning called Xu Yaran at noon, she learned that her mother was directly asked to go to work before she had finished the interview. She felt that her father was so fast!
Thinking of work, Xu Yaran wanted to roar, "The rumors are indeed lies. They say that Ye Jue has eight secretaries. When I went to take a look, Mao didn't see any of them. Mommy has been filing documents all day and is exhausted!"
"..."
Baby Ningning was silent, Mommy, I'm sorry for you. He just wanted to get his mommy to his daddy's side as soon as possible, but he actually forgot about this.
"So mommy... how is the environment at Night Emperor? Is the new boss very aggressive?" Baby Ningning was beating around the bush.
Xu Yaran thought of Ye Jue and then looked at baby Ning Ning in front of her... Those facial features and eyebrows were so similar, they were obviously carved from the same mold!
Xu Yaran felt extremely resentful. She was so young and ignorant back then. Even if Ye Jue wasn't so domineering and cold back then, she couldn't regard him as a publicist despite his coquettish appearance! ! !
She even left her previous mobile phone number!
He also said... He didn't mean to pay for whoring... Xu Yaran could imagine how depressed Ye Jue felt when he saw the note she left!
Xu Yaran's expression was ever-changing. Ning Ning hurriedly asked, "Mommy, what's wrong? Is the new boss difficult?" His father can't be that perverted, right?
"Not only is he difficult to deal with, he is simply a psychopath. Mommy loses her appetite and is in a bad mood when she sees him!"
"..."
Baby Ningning is almost sure that her mommy is remembering her daddy, but...this memory doesn't seem to be a good one!
Baby Ningning realized her mistake and hurriedly changed the email address used by Yehuang to recruit the president's secretary. Within a few days, four more people were hired, all of whom were white-collar beauties with rich work experience and good conversational skills.
There was also one who had also served as Bullock's secretary at SK International Group for one year, named Bai Lili, who was three years older than Xu Yaran. When the two talked about Bullock's perverted habits, they both pounded the table and roared..
Bai Lili was very surprised that Xu Yaran was able to work under Bullock for more than two years at such a young age. You must know how perverted Bullock is. On average, he has to change secretaries once a month. The requirements are very high. Adding an extra spoon of sugar to the coffee is not enough, and he cannot be a nymphomaniac and a vase.
Xu Yaran also had a good impression of Bai Lili, and the two of them got along very well.
The remaining three people are named Zhang Jiayun, Xue Limin, and Yuan Yuan.
Xu Yaran always smiles when she sees people. She has always had good interpersonal relationships. In addition, she is similar in age to these people, so she quickly got along with them.
On Friday afternoon, since there was no need to go to work tomorrow, Zhang Jiayun proposed to go out to eat and sing K together to celebrate the new addition to the Night Emperor.
After a hard week, Xu Yaran originally wanted to go back early to spend time with her two little babies, so she wanted to refuse. However, seeing that everyone was new to the job and very enthusiastic except for her, she did not refuse.
Ye Jue looked at the five women in the secretary's office through the glass window, and his eyes fell on Xu Yaran. This woman looked more and more familiar, but he couldn't remember where he had seen her before... Ye Jue didn't like this feeling, very much!
